title: novelty.audit_requested (v1)
description: Entry action following ReinterpretingSpec (state machine V1.10 §1): ResearchOrchestrator instructs NoveltyAuditAgent to audit the reinterpreted ResearchSpec against prior literature. Payload is intentionally minimal: the ResearchSpec, LiteratureBrief, and SpecInterpretation are read from the Research Store by ref rather than from this payload. NoveltyAuditAgent itself is out of scope for this task -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen (possibly revised) ResearchSpec object.

literature_brief_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen LiteratureBrief object.

spec_interpretation_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen SpecInterpretation object.

evidence_audit_report_ref.description: Optional opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen EvidenceAuditReport object (EvidenceAuditAgent's Mode A co-audit at AuditingLiteratureNovelty), so NoveltyAuditAgent's verdict is evidence-informed. Null/absent when no evidence audit has run yet.

method_ref.description: Frozen method whose novelty and feasibility are being audited.
